COMPANY

At 0x, our mission is to "Create a Tokenized World Where All Forms of Value Can Flow Freely". We deliver this to web3 builders with a delightfully simple suite of developer APIs that provide faster trading, better prices, and superior user experience.

Founded in 2017, we’ve processed over 211M+ transactions and $180B+ in trading volume from users trading on Matcha, Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet, Phantom, Rainbow, DefiLlama, MetaMask, Zerion, Zapper, and many more. Our investors include Greylock Partners, Pantera Capital, and Jump Crypto.

When you join 0x, you’ll become part of a veteran team of crypto builders who know the importance of code quality, team cohesion, and a culture of learning.


About the role

We’re hiring a Head of Marketing to take 0x through its next stage of growth. You’ll join our leadership team, report directly to our founder and CEO, and own marketing strategy across 0x APIs, our suite of onchain trading APIs, and Matcha, our consumer DEX aggregator.

You’ll own the narrative behind both brands. You’ll build on our strong footing with cryptonative teams while defining how we take our APIs to fintechs, enterprises and institutions. We’re looking for someone who understands DeFi deeply, thinks from first principles and builds for the long term.

You’ll lead a senior marketing team, unite them around clear priorities and build one cohesive, high-impact marketing function. You’re as comfortable doing the work as you are leading it. You’ll stay close to the business, joining key customer conversations and getting directly involved in positioning and major launches.

Strong overlap with US working hours is required.

What you'll do

  • Own marketing strategy across 0x APIs and Matcha, setting long-term marketing plans based on company and product goals, including API adoption and Matcha's consumer growth.

  • Refine positioning and narratives for 0x APIs and Matcha, defining and maintaining clear ICPs, strengthening our cryptonative presence, and expanding 0x APIs' appeal to fintechs, enterprises, and institutions.

  • Guide the evolution of both brands, setting creative and website direction and ensuring a distinctive, consistent presence across channels.

  • Build and scale marketing programs that drive growth, identifying the highest-leverage opportunities for each product and audience.

  • Partner closely with Sales to generate qualified API demand, align marketing with commercial priorities, and equip the team with the content and materials needed to win customers.

  • Lead the marketing team, setting clear priorities and ownership, automating and improving processes with AI, giving constructive feedback and coaching experienced marketers, and protecting their focus by managing cross-team requests.

  • Produce work yourself, from positioning and launch plans to campaigns and content, adding to the team’s output and stepping in wherever extra capacity is needed.

  • Own marketing performance and budget, tracking spend, ROI and marketing’s contribution to revenue, and keep the company informed on progress.

  • Stay deep in the data, using Dune, DefiLlama and internal analytics to understand market trends, competitors and product adoption, and let it guide marketing decisions.

What you’ll bring

  • 8+ years in marketing, including 3+ years leading a marketing function.

  • Experience setting company-wide marketing strategy across multiple product lines, shaping distinct positioning and narratives for the audiences each one serves.

  • Experience marketing both technical B2B products, ideally APIs or core infrastructure, and consumer products.

  • Deep roots in crypto, including time at a crypto company. You use DeFi products, follow CT, and know how DEXs, aggregators, liquidity providers, wallets and trading apps fit together and where infrastructure like 0x creates value.

  • A track record of building repeatable marketing programs that drove measurable business growth.

  • Experience leading senior marketers as a player-coach and bringing them together as a cohesive, focused team.

  • Experience at a DEX, aggregator or onchain trading infrastructure company.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Visual Designer to join the Visual System Team, the team responsible for how OKX looks and feels across every product surface, including mobile and web. You’ll work at the intersection of brand expression and product design, crafting the visual layer that makes OKX products feel distinctive, coherent, and trusted.
This isn’t a role where you receive a finalized wireframe and simply apply a visual layer. You’ll be involved early, shaping how features are visually conceived, how brand moments are integrated into product flows, and how visual systems scale across an ecosystem of products used by millions.
You’ll work within OKX’s Visual Systems infrastructure alongside the Design System and Content System teams, contributing to scalable visual frameworks including illustration guidelines, motion principles, iconography standards, and brand-in-product patterns that raise quality across the entire product.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design product visual experiences. Create high-quality visual and UI designs for OKX products across trading, wallet, payments, and social features. Own the visual execution of key product surfaces, from concept through to pixel-perfect delivery. Balance beauty with clarity in a domain where trust and usability are non-negotiable.
  • Contribute to visual systems. Work within and contribute to OKX’s visual systems, including shared illustration styles, motion tokens, color systems, iconography, layout patterns, UI components, and design tokens. Your work should strengthen the system, not create one-off exceptions. Think in terms of reusable, scalable assets and patterns, not just individual
  • Bridge brand and product. Translate brand direction into in-product visual experiences. Work with the Brand Design team to ensure that visual identity is consistent from marketing to core product, while adapting it thoughtfully to product goals, user needs, and performance metrics. You’ll help create room for the product’s own visual expression without going off-brand.
  • Design product campaigns and key moments. Create engaging visual experiences for in-product campaigns, launches, and feature moments. These should feel distinctive and expressive while remaining native to the product experience and aligned with the broader brand.
  • Use AI tools in your design workflow. Actively integrate AI into your daily practice using generative tools for ideation, exploration, variation, prototyping, and asset production. You’re expected to experiment with AI-assisted workflows and bring what works back to the team. This is a core part of how we work, not an optional extra.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner with product designers, engineers, and product managers to ensure visual design decisions are grounded in user needs and technically feasible. Participate in design reviews, give and receive critique constructively, and communicate your rationale clearly.
  • Pitch and present. Propose creative concepts to team leads and stakeholders. Articulate the reasoning behind visual choices, not just what you designed, but why it is the right solution for the user and the brand.

What We Look For In You

  • 4–6 years of experience in visual design, UI design, a digital-focused role within a brand team, or a related discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong craft, modern taste, and attention to detail.
  • Experience taking product experiences from wireframes to polished, production-ready UI. You understand how visual design supports usability, hierarchy, trust, product goals, and measurable outcomes, not just aesthetics.
  • Strong UI and digital design fundamentals across product, responsive web, and mobile experiences. Mobile-first experience is essential.
  • Exceptional visual craft across typography, color, composition, layout, interaction, and detail. You have a clear point of view, make thoughtful design decisions, and care about the polish that separates good from great.
  • Experience creating or contributing to scalable design systems. You understand tokens, components, patterns, and how to create a coherent visual language across a product.
  • Comfortable working at the intersection of brand and product. You can translate brand direction into product experiences that meet user and business needs while leaving room for distinctive product expression.
  • AI-forward in your practice. You actively use generative tools for ideation, exploration, prototyping, and production, and are excited to experiment with new workflows. You use AI with strong creative judgment, refining outputs rather than relying on unedited generated assets, and look for ways to make visual work more scalable.
  • A clear, collaborative communicator who can articulate design rationale and work effectively with product designers, engineers, product managers, and Brand Design.
  • Proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools, with the ability to communicate interaction and motion intent through high-fidelity prototypes.
  • Experience creating light animation is a strong plus. Experience with 3D software or a genuine willingness to learn is also highly valued.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience designing for fintech, crypto, or trading platforms — you understand the visual language of trust, precision, and data density.
  • Strong visual. illustration and interaction idea skills — you can create original visual assets, not just compose them.
  • An exceptional eye for layout, composition, and hierarchy. You can turn ideas into clear, high-quality visual solutions quickly and decisively.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, balancing speed with a high bar for craft and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams across offices and time zones.
  • Familiarity with how visual design integrates with front-end implementation. You understand CSS, design tokens, and component architecture well enough to collaborate effectively with engineers.

  • Installs and configures complex server and networking systems

  • Provides comprehensive on-site facility support, including installation, decommissioning, and break/fix work

Chief Compliance Officer & BSA Officer
Location: Norfolk, Nebraska - Flexible (remote, hybrid or on-site)
Company: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank (TDAB)

About Telcoin Digital Asset Bank
Telcoin Digital Asset Bank (TDAB) is a Nebraska-chartered digital asset depository institution that brings regulated banking and blockchain-based financial services together, including digital asset custody, stablecoin issuance and redemption, and on-chain payments. As we build out the Bank’s operations, we are looking for an experienced compliance leader to establish and scale a strong, risk-based financial crimes compliance program.

The Role
We are looking for a Chief Compliance Officer who will also serve as the Board-designated BSA Officer. The successful candidate will own the Bank’s BSA/AML, counter-terrorist financing and OFAC sanctions compliance program across both fiat and digital asset activity.

This senior leadership role reports to the Board Risk/Audit Committee. It is the Bank’s primary BSA/AML contact for the state banking regulator, FinCEN, OFAC and federal partners.

Key Responsibilities

Program ownership and governance

  • Update, implement, and maintain a risk-based BSA/AML/CFT and OFAC program covering the five pillars: internal controls, independent testing, a designated BSA Officer, training, and customer due diligence including beneficial ownership.
  • Draft and annually refresh BSA/AML and sanctions policies, procedures, and the Board-approved risk appetite.
  • Report program status, metrics, and material issues to the Board and senior management at least quarterly.
  • Own the enterprise BSA/AML and sanctions risk assessment, including products, customers, geographies, delivery channels, and digital asset types.

Customer due diligence

  • Oversee CIP, KYC, KYB, and enhanced due diligence for retail, institutional, and VASP/counterparty customers.
  • Set customer risk-rating methodology and periodic review cycles.
  • Approve onboarding of high-risk customers, including other virtual asset service providers, money services businesses, and foreign correspondents.

Transaction monitoring and blockchain analytics

  • Oversee fiat and on-chain transaction monitoring, including blockchain analytics tools (e.g., Chainalysis, Sumsub) for wallet screening, exposure analysis, and tracing.
  • Tune scenarios and thresholds; document model validation and above/below-the-line testing.
  • Address digital-asset typologies: mixers and privacy tools, darknet markets, ransomware, chain-hopping, bridge exploits, and sanctioned addresses.

Travel Rule and sanctions

  • Implement FinCEN Recordkeeping and Travel Rule compliance and FATF Recommendation 16 for virtual asset transfers, including counterparty VASP due diligence.
  • Run OFAC and global sanctions screening of customers, transactions, and wallet addresses (including SDN-listed addresses); manage blocking, rejection, and reporting obligations.

Investigations and regulatory reporting

  • Manage alert and case investigations; make final SAR filing decisions and ensure timely filing and continuing-activity reviews.
  • Ensure accurate and timely CTRs, 314(a) responses, 314(b) information sharing, and responses to subpoenas and law enforcement requests.

Stablecoin and custody controls

  • Establish AML controls for stablecoin issuance, redemption, reserves-related flows, and freeze/blacklist capabilities in coordination with Legal and Engineering.
  • Ensure custody and wallet-management processes meet recordkeeping and monitoring requirements.

Exams, audits, and training

  • Serve as primary contact for BSA/AML portions of regulatory examinations and independent audits; own remediation of findings.
  • Deliver role-based BSA/AML training for the Board, employees, and contractors, with tailored digital asset content.
  • Evaluate and oversee third-party compliance vendors and partner-bank or program-manager arrangements.

Team leadership and scaling

  • Build, staff, and lead the financial crimes compliance team; set QA standards and KPIs.
  • Design a compliance operating model that grows with the business, and plan staffing, tooling, and process needs ahead of growth in customers, transaction volumes, products, and jurisdictions.
  • Develop talent through clear career paths, succession planning and ongoing professional development.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to embed compliance controls into new products before launch.

Budget and financial management

  • Own the compliance function’s P&L and annual budget, covering headcount, technology, blockchain analytics and screening vendors, independent testing, and training.
  • Build business cases for compliance investment, with cost, benefit, and risk-reduction analysis, and present them to senior management and the Board.
  • Track compliance unit costs, such as cost per onboarded customer and per investigated alert, and find efficiencies as volumes grow.
  • Work with Finance and business leaders to reflect compliance costs and risks in product pricing, new-market entry, and partnership decisions.
  • Negotiate and manage vendor contracts to get value while meeting regulatory standards.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, criminal justice, law, business or a related field.
  • 8+ years of BSA/AML compliance experience at a bank, trust company or regulated money transmitter, including 3+ years as a BSA Officer, deputy or program lead.
  • 2+ years of direct experience with digital assets, virtual currency or a VASP/crypto exchange.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp's Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team is looking for a senior investigator ready to shift from running cases to scaling the systems that run cases. You've built real depth in TM Alerts, AML Investigations, Complex Fraud, and EDD Reviews; you know what a good escalation looks like, where analysts get stuck, and where automation actually holds up in production versus just looks good in a demo. In this role, you'll spend most of your time partnering with Engineering and the Head of FCC Tooling to turn that judgment into scaled AI systems: testing model outputs, labeling and calibrating results, and making sure every automated decision point is well-documented and properly governed. You'll stay close enough to FCC's day-to-day workflows and will partake in some of them, but this is fundamentally a builder role.

 

What You'll Do

  • Partner directly with Engineering and the Head of FCC Tooling on automation experimentation and AI initiatives across TM, sanctions, complex fraud, and EDD, moving prototypes from one-off calibration exercises to defined, repeatable evaluation processes.

  • Design and run labeling and tagging workflows for model outputs (e.g., TM alert dispositions, sanctions/PEP hit review) building a structured, documented pipeline in place of today's ad hoc process

  • Define and maintain test sets, scenario coverage, and evaluation frameworks for compliance AI/agent tools in partnership with the engineers building them

  • Own the documentation and governance layer for every automated or AI-assisted decision point

  • Work with the FCC team to understand current workflows to guide innovative solutions

  • Recommend automation and AI adoption decisions with evidence and escalate control-posture or model-risk trade-offs to compliance leadership

 

What You Need

  • 5+ years of financial services experience in compliance, AML, or related regulatory advisory roles, preferably in fintech

  • Demonstrated senior-investigator experience across TM Alerts, AML Investigations, Complex Fraud, and EDD Reviews

  • Direct experience testing, labeling, or evaluating AI/ML model outputs, or strong aptitude and demonstrated fast ramp-up if new to formal model evaluation

  • Strong AI fluency and data analytics skills

  • Comfort partnering with engineers day-to-day and ability to translate compliance judgment into build specs, test cases, and evaluation criteria engineers can act on

  • Strong project management and documentation rigor

  • Ability to scope an ambiguous automation problem, choose an approach, and deliver a durable outcome with minimal oversight

     

Nice-to-Haves

  • Data science background

  • Experience working with outsourced testing/QA partners on model tuning or signal collection

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

  • One Medical annual membership

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

About the Company

Sei Labs is a unicorn startup based in NYC building Sei, the fastest EVM blockchain in the world designed for trading. We're building a decentralized Wall Street. We're a lean, remote-first team that ships fast, takes full ownership of outcomes and builds from first principles.

Sei Labs is incubating a new US regulated exchange from zero to one. You'd be the first hire in your function, with the speed and ownership of a startup and the backing of an established company and an S-tier team (Robinhood, Coinbase, Google, etc.)

About the role

As our initial Risk Manager, you will be the day-to-day lead of the FCM's independent Risk Management Unit and will administer, maintain and enhance its Risk Management Program. You will establish and monitor risk limits, assess customer and firm exposures, conduct stress testing, oversee margin and liquidation risk, and escalate material risk matters directly to senior management. You will work closely with Finance, Operations, Technology and Compliance while maintaining the independence required of the RMU.

What you'll do

  • Risk Management Program: help write and maintain the FCM's Risk Management Program under CFTC Regulation 1.11, including risk appetite, tolerance limits, methodologies and escalation paths.

  • Limits and monitoring: set and monitor pre-trade and intraday limits for market, credit, margin, concentration and volume exposure. Detect breaches and escalate them promptly to senior management.

  • Margin, credit and liquidation risk: Develop and monitor the FCM's customer-margin and risk-limit framework, including house margin add-ons where appropriate, customer credit and concentration limits, deficit monitoring, liquidation thresholds and escalation procedures for accounts experiencing adverse market movements.

  • Stress testing: run stress tests, scenario analysis and exposure aggregation across customers, products and venues.

  • Liquidity, capital and counterparties: monitor liquidity, capital, and counterparty and depository exposure with Finance. Provide risk oversight of customer-fund segregation and residual interest.

  • Settlement and operational risk: Assess clearing, settlement, contract-expiration, technology, data and third-party risks, including controls around order entry, position management and settlement. Where applicable, assess risks associated with contracts approaching expiration or final settlement.

  • Risk governance and reporting: Prepare quarterly Risk Exposure Reports for senior management, as well as interim reports when material changes in risk exposure occur, and coordinate required regulatory filings. Track recommended RMP changes and remediation items through completion.

  • New business: assess the risk of new products, venues and clearing relationships before launch.

What you bring

  • 4–8 years in market, credit or margin risk at an FCM, clearing firm, DCO, broker-dealer or trading firm.

  • Strong command of futures and derivatives margining (SPAN or similar), exposure measurement and liquidation practices.

  • Hands-on experience with limits, stress testing and risk reporting to senior management.

  • Working knowledge of FCM risk obligations, including Regulation 1.11, segregation and capital.

  • Strong quantitative and data skills (Python, SQL or advanced Excel).

  • Clear written communication for governance and regulatory reporting.

  • The independence and judgment to challenge the business when needed.

  • Comfort building process from scratch in a fast-moving 0-to-1 environment.

  • A clean regulatory record, with no NFA or FINRA disciplinary history.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a retail-facing or technology-first FCM.

  • Perpetual futures, 24/7 markets, crypto or stablecoin collateral experience.

  • Exposure to helping build or reviewing a Risk Management Program, or to CFTC/NFA exams.

  • FRM, CFA or similar certification.

Molecule and BIO.xyz are building the foundation of Decentralized Science (DeSci) — where biotech meets web3 to make scientific research community-owned, transparent, and faster to market.

Molecule provides the infrastructure to turn intellectual property (IP) into programmable, on-chain assets through our IP-NFT framework and evolving protocol stack. This enables researchers, patients, and communities to fund and govern biotech projects in new, open ways.

BIO.xyz is the coordination and economic layer of DeSci, powering BioDAOs through funding, governance, and ecosystem alignment.

Together, we are creating a new model for scientific discovery — one where breakthroughs are owned and advanced by the communities that believe in them.

We’re looking for a senior Product Designer to shape the user experience and visual language of Molecule’s web and mobile products. You’ll turn product goals and complex requirements into clear, intuitive interfaces, and you’ll own the design system that keeps everything we ship consistent.

You’ll sit within the Product team and work closely with Engineering and Marketing. You’ll take work from first concept through to pixel-perfect execution and implementation. We move fast, so we value iteration over perfection, quick prototypes over long specs, and designers who are comfortable using AI tools to explore ideas and test them early.

This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a component library as in a whiteboard session. It suits someone who wants to define what great product design looks like in a space where the rules are still being written.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design and refine the user experience and interfaces for Molecule’s core applications across web and mobile, working within the Product team from concept to launch

  • Own and expand Molecule’s Design System by building and maintaining a scalable, accessible component library that keeps every product consistent

  • Deliver polished, pixel-perfect UI components that improve usability and clarity and stay aligned with our brand

  • Write clear component documentation, UI specs, and usage guidelines so handoff from design to development runs smoothly

  • Partner with Frontend Engineers through implementation to make sure what ships matches what was designed

  • Apply WCAG standards and UX best practices to make our products inclusive and easy to use

  • Build interactive prototypes, often with AI-powered tools, to explore ideas and test them with users quickly

  • Iterate on designs based on user feedback, data, and evolving product needs

  • Lead and facilitate design work, including setting up frameworks, running brainstorms, and presenting and defending design decisions to stakeholders

  • Contribute to Molecule’s broader visual identity across product and communications, working with external design partners on brand assets where needed

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have 7+ years of professional product or UI design experience, ideally on complex products

  • You have built and scaled design systems and hybrid component libraries across teams, and your portfolio shows it, including component libraries and detailed UI documentation

  • You’re a Figma expert with hands-on experience managing a design system in it

  • You understand HTML, CSS, and front-end frameworks well enough to design for feasibility and speak engineering’s language

  • You have a strong grasp of interaction design for both mobile and desktop

  • You actively use AI tools and AI-enhanced workflows in your design process

  • You’re ego-free and collaborative. You seek out feedback and critique and keep pushing your craft forward

  • You’re self-sufficient. You own the design process end to end, manage feedback, and drive execution without micromanagement

  • You communicate clearly and can explain the reasoning behind your work to designers, engineers, and leadership alike

NICE TO HAVE

  • You’ve shipped AI or agent-based product experiences

  • You build and test working prototypes yourself, picking the right tool for the question at hand

  • Experience with design tokens and front-end design implementation

  • Knowledge of user testing methodologies and iterative research practices

  • Experience working with external design or branding agencies

  • Background in web3, biotech, or decentralised science

WHY MOLECULE

  • The chance to define the product experience of a category, building the interfaces through which researchers, patients, and communities fund and govern science

  • Real ownership in a young, fast-growing team where your voice shapes both the product and the company

  • A team that values substance over titles, speed over process, and people who’ve built their way up

  • Competitive compensation

Crypto.com is one of the world's leading cryptocurrency platforms, serving over 100 million customers globally. Through its acquisition of the North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (Nadex), Crypto.com operates a CFTC-regulated designated contract market (FCM/DCM) in the United States, offering derivatives and event contracts to U.S. participants. The Opportunity

descriptions.job-0alcz39:
Chainalysis is the leader in blockchain intelligence, defining how trust is built in the digital economy. We're operating at the cutting edge of one of the world's fastest-growing industries, shaping what comes next. Over the last 2 years, Chainalysis has made big bets and moved fast to capture the market opportunity in front of us: we've accelerated growth, landed enterprise-wide contracts at the world's largest financial institutions, completed acquisitions to build our AI talent and expand our products, and launched our first agentic products.

At Chainalysis, the enablement team exists to drive the effectiveness, capacity, and productivity of our customer-facing teams. As the Head of Enablement, you will lead this globally-distributed team and build the relationships, programs, infrastructure, and operating model to help us capture the opportunity in front of us. You’ll report to the GTM Chief of Staff and work across the entire business to drive alignment around our biggest priorities.

In this role, you'll:

  • Build the enablement organization into an operational juggernaut through deep, integrated partnerships with leaders across the business and a strong, foundational relationship with product management and product marketing

  • Design and implement the enablement operating model from the ground up: intake process, prioritization framework, content lifecycle, central calendar, and a single front door for requests.

  • Own the enablement tech stack (LMS, AI role-play, conversation intelligence) and build manager-facing dashboards that give sales leaders visibility into their teams' readiness.

  • Translate completed Product Marketing positioning briefs into curriculum, practice programs, battle cards, and field-ready content kits. Enablement does not create messaging. It makes messaging land.

  • Lead the work to transform the current checklist-based onboarding with a structured, curriculum-based program with clear ramp milestones, and scale it to absorb 25+ new sellers in the first quarter of FY28.

  • Build enablement analytics from scratch. Define metrics tied to pipeline, win rate, ramp time, and consumption growth. Demonstrate the function's business impact with data.

  • Extend enablement beyond account executives to serve Solutions Architects, Customer Success Managers, Global Services, and channel partners. Align frameworks so every customer-facing team speaks the same language.

  • Lead and stabilize a very talented team that has been through significant organizational change. Provide clear vision, invest in development, and build a culture where people do the best work of their careers.

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • 10+ years of experience in sales, customer success, enablement, revenue operations, GTM operations, or a related operational function within complex B2B SaaS companies

  • Built or materially scaled a function, program, or operational capability from early stage. You have a track record of creating structure where there was none.

  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguity: you've operated in environments where the strategy was iterative, the infrastructure was incomplete, and you had to build while leading. You bring resilience and grit, not just skill.

  • Hands-on operational instinct. You are an operator first, and you build systems, design processes, introduce automation, and do the work yourself when that's what the situation demands. You are not looking for a role where you set strategy and delegate execution.

  • Direct experience working with or inside a strong sales enablement function. You understand what good looks like, even if your career hasn't been spent exclusively in enablement.

  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones, and a passion for developing people

  • Product curiosity and enough understanding of product-to-market motions to maintain credibility with Product Marketing and Product teams.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with senior leaders, sales managers, and cross-functional partners quickly.

Nice to have experience:

  • Knowledge of Force Management, Command of the Message, or MEDDPICC.

  • Prior experience as a quota-carrying account executive or in a direct selling role.

  • Experience working in or with financial services, the public sector, or compliance-related industries (financial crime, AML/CFT, payments, trading systems).

  • Experience with enablement technology platforms (LMS, conversation intelligence, AI role-play tools).

  • Experience supporting a business model transition (for example, from subscription to consumption pricing).

  • Interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain, and related technologies, or a deep curiosity and willingness to learn.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

In this role, you will be joining the High Availability and Disaster Recovery team. At Stripe, availability is a core feature of our products. This team designs and builds new solutions to allow latency-critical, stateful applications to survive any type of disaster. We build distributed systems on top of unreliable architecture to provide highly available and resilient customer solutions. This team is creating greenfield solutions which will serve as the basis for Stripe’s architecture 5, 10, or 20 years into the future.

This is a distributed team with many remote engineers. You are encouraged to apply if you meet the minimum requirements and are able to work from anywhere in the United States or Canada.

What you’ll do

You will help develop our global architecture by combining less-available components and data centers into a highly available and resilient whole. You will work on latency-critical solutions where every millisecond matters and data redundancy is a hard requirement. You will learn quickly and work on a broad range of problems - one day may be investigating Mongo write concerns, the next may be minimizing cross-region TLS handshakes, followed by developing new systems to automate disaster detection and failovers. Your work will enable Stripe to increase the GDP of the internet by providing uptime and data protection which have historically been impossible.

Responsibilities

  • Actively work with leaders and engineers across the company to understand and identify opportunities to improve Stripe’s reliability  posture
  • Scope, design, implement, and deploy robust distributed services, making appropriate tradeoffs between reliability, throughput, latency, resiliency, engineering velocity and cost
  • Innovate, design and implement new products and prototypes to improve service resiliency, engineering velocity and management at scale
  • Mentor and grow the next generation of technical leaders at Stripe
  • Contribute to engineering strategy, tooling, processes, and culture
  • Uphold our high engineering standards and improve our codebase and processes

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Have 10 years or more of distributed and cloud native software development experience at a highly-scaled or hyperscaler service
  • Have a deep understanding of how to build scalable, resilient, distributed systems, cloud native architectures, and mission critical systems.
  • Have experience influencing, planning, scoping, and leading large projects across many teams
  • Thrive in a collaborative environment involving diverse stakeholders and subject matter experts
  • Have a high level of autonomy and responsibility, and think of yourself as entrepreneurial, proactive and self-driven
  • Have a strong history of being a technical lead and mentor across several engineering teams

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

The Money Movement team at Paxos owns the layer that moves assets in, out, and across our platform: the payment rails, fiat on/off ramps, and stablecoin conversion flows that connect Paxos to the global banking and payments system. We work with the world's largest financial institutions and banking partners, alongside Compliance and Legal, to build fast, reliable, and compliant infrastructure that lets the largest enterprises and move billions of dollars in and out of digital assets.

Join us in tokenizing the world's assets and democratizing access to financial infrastructure. As the Senior Product Manager for Money Movement, you'll own the layer that moves assets in, out, and across Paxos—the payment rails, on/off ramps, and the logic that ties them together. Fiat on/off ramp and seamless stablecoin conversion will always be critical pieces of our blockchain infrastructure, and you'll own the strategy, roadmap, and execution end to end.

  • Shape Regulatory Standards: Collaborate with compliance and legal teams to set industry standards for regulated fiat movement, influencing how the entire ecosystem evolves.

About You

  • 8-10 years of Product Management experience with a passion for transformative technology

  • Domain Depth: Direct experience with fiat rails, payments, banking partnerships, on/off ramps, stablecoin swaps/conversion, or transaction orchestration is a plus

  • Visionary Mindset: You see beyond current limitations and get excited about rebuilding fundamental infrastructure

  • Technical Fluency: Comfortable with APIs, payment and banking integrations, and the complex systems that power global financial networks

  • Ownership & Autonomy: You operate independently, structure ambiguous problems quickly, and drive initiatives to results without top-down guidance

  • Data-Driven: You use analytics to drive decisions and optimize products that operate at massive scale

  • Mission Alignment: Passionate about financial inclusion and democratizing access to financial services

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with stablecoins, tokenization, or digital asset infrastructure

We're looking for an AI Inference Platform Engineer to build, operate, and optimize the systems that serve large language, vision, multimodal, and embedding models across DRW. This role provides DRW's firmwide interface to modern AI models, from early evaluation through reliable production use. 

You'll work across inference runtimes, distributed systems, and production platform engineering, with deep GPU literacy.  You'll own the serving platform end-to-end: onboarding newly released models, measuring quality and performance equivalence across serving configurations, scheduling workloads across tenants, and continuously improving latency, throughput, utilization, reliability, and cost across the inference fleet. 

What You'll Do 

  • Optimize LLM inference performance across modern NVIDIA GPU architectures and inference runtimes. 
  • Build end-to-end performance profiling and observability to identify bottlenecks from individual GPU kernels through multi-node inference systems. 
  • Design and optimize KV cache and distributed inference architectures, including caching, routing, memory tiering, and prefill/decode strategies. 
  • Own day-0 model onboarding, determining the appropriate runtime, precision, sharding, memory, batching, cache policy, and serving configuration for new models. 
  • Maintain validated performance profiles for important model and hardware combinations, including performance and quality regression testing. 
  • Measure and monitor quality equivalence across serving configurations, including KV cache quantization, speculative decoding acceptance thresholds, precision choices, and model routing, so in-house serving can be trusted to match reference-model quality on production workloads. 
  • Manage the production serving lifecycle of models, including versioning, compatibility, staging, canarying, promotion, rollback, and retirement. 
  • Partner with SRE and platform teams to automate model deployment, distribution, production readiness, observability, and reliable operation across environments. 
  • Optimize model placement, scaling, and resource allocation across the inference fleet to improve utilization and cost efficiency while meeting performance and reliability requirements. 
  • Design and operate multi-tenant scheduling and isolation across shared GPU capacity, balancing latency SLOs, throughput, and priority across concurrent workloads. 

What We're Looking For 

The Tech 

  • Hands-on experience serving LLMs on NVIDIA GPUs, with familiarity across current and emerging architectures (Hopper, Blackwell, and successors), HBM, Tensor Cores, NVLink/NVSwitch, and the compute and memory bottlenecks that shape serving decisions. 
  • Deep expertise in at least one modern inference runtime such as TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, or SGLang. 
  • Practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques including continuous batching, scheduling, chunked prefill, speculative decoding, quantization, CUDA Graphs, and paged attention. 
  • Understanding of KV cache architecture, including prefix caching, block management, sizing, eviction, quantization, cache-aware routing, and multi-tier caching. 
  • Experience measuring model quality equivalence across serving configurations, including evaluation harnesses, task-specific benchmarks, and regression detection for quantization, KV cache, and speculative decoding changes. 
  • Experience designing and tuning distributed inference systems, including tensor parallelism, multi-node deployments, and disaggregated prefill and decode. 
  • Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling, workload isolation, and QoS across concurrent inference workloads. 
  • Proficiency with GPU performance and observability tooling such as Nsight, DCGM, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
  • Strong Linux and systems performance fundamentals, with the ability to diagnose bottlenecks across hardware, drivers, runtimes, networking, and application layers. 
  • Production experience with model serving infrastructure, including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production readiness. 

The Intangibles 

  • You take a measurement-driven approach to performance optimization. 
  • You take ownership of performance problems across hardware, runtime, model, and infrastructure boundaries. 
  • You can move quickly and reprioritize as trading needs change, while maintaining a high bar for production systems. 
  • You understand the importance of reliability, predictability, and performance when AI systems are integrated into trading workflows and decision-making processes. 
  • You can evaluate unfamiliar models, runtimes, and hardware quickly and make sound engineering decisions with limited prior guidance. 
  • You communicate clearly and can explain complex performance tradeoffs across engineering teams.

You’ll work across smart contracts, protocol design, blockchain infrastructure, indexing, monitoring, and the systems that turn on-chain activity into reliable products.

This is not a role where you only write contracts. We care deeply about how protocols work in production: how events are indexed, how state is reconstructed, how off-chain systems respond to on-chain activity, and how we make the overall system reliable and usable at scale.

You’ll have significant ownership over architecture, implementation, security, and the technical foundations of Open Standard.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build smart contracts supporting OUSD across multiple blockchains.

  • Build infrastructure around minting, burning, transfers, rewards, and other protocol functionality.

  • Design indexing and event-driven systems that reliably turn on-chain activity into usable off-chain state.

  • Build monitoring and alerting systems for critical protocol events and anomalous behavior.

  • Design systems that can handle reorgs, duplicate events, delayed events, and other realities of blockchain infrastructure.

  • Work across on-chain and off-chain systems rather than treating smart contracts in isolation.

  • Own projects from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Work closely with the founding team and external partners on protocol integrations.

  • Contribute to security reviews, testing, and overall protocol architecture.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful experience building blockchain systems.

  • Strong experience with Solidity and EVM-based smart contracts, or equivalent experience on other major chains.

  • Strong understanding of blockchain architecture, transaction lifecycle, cryptographic principles, and smart contract security.

  • Experience building and operating production smart contracts.

  • Experience with indexing blockchain data and building off-chain systems around on-chain protocols.

  • Strong understanding of event-driven architecture and event sourcing, including how to reconstruct and reconcile state from blockchain events.

  • Comfortable reasoning about reorgs, idempotency, eventual consistency, retries, and failure modes across on-chain and off-chain systems.

  • Strong ownership and the ability to independently drive technical decisions.
